name: How long does it take to frame a new window opening?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to frame a new window opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to frame a new window opening varies depending on several factors, including the size of the opening, whether it's a load-bearing wall, and the complexity of the wall construction. For a single, straightforward window in a non-load-bearing wall, the framing process might take a few hours to a full day. For multiple windows, larger openings, or load-bearing walls requiring temporary structural support, the framing work could extend over several days. This estimate does not include the time for window installation or finishing work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing a new window can take a few hours to several days, depending on size, whether it's a load-bearing wall, and overall complexity. This excludes actual window installation time.
